title: Animal Crossing
note: Unofficial Windows, Linux, macOS, Android and iOS port of Animal Crossing for GameCube; bring your own disc image.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD
note: Wind Waker HD running natively on Android through static recompilation and Vulkan; bring your own game files.

title: Halo: Combat Evolved
note: Halo CE ported for Windows, macOS, Linux, Steam Deck, FreeBSD and Android; requires your own game data.

title: Unreal
note: Port of the 1998 shooter Unreal (v200) for Android 8 and newer, 32-bit and 64-bit builds; requires your own game files.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Phantom Hourglass
note: Native PC and Android port of Phantom Hourglass by static recompilation; bring your own ROM.

title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
note: Unofficial Android arm64 port of the Jak and Daxter trilogy powered by OpenGOAL; bring your own game files.

title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
note: Static recompilation of Super Mario Bros. Wonder with Vulkan rendering for macOS, Android and desktop; bring your own game files.

title: Prototype
note: Current native ARM64 Android port of Prototype (2009), replacing the discontinued ProtoRe listing. Requires your legally obtained PC game files; the APK does not contain them.

title: Grand Theft Auto IV
note: Android ARM64 static recompilation of the Xbox 360 game. The maintainer says the project is on hiatus; Adreno is the tested target and Mali support is experimental. Bring your own game dump.

title: Pikmin
source: Awesome Android Native Ports follow-up research
note: Native Android port with touch and controller support. Most of the game is playable; bring your own supported GameCube disc image.

title: Pikmin 2
source: Awesome Android Native Ports follow-up research
note: Playable from start to finish on the project's documented USA and European discs. Bring your own supported GameCube disc image.

title: Open Nectar
source: Awesome Android Native Ports follow-up research
description: A native launcher for Pikmin and Pikmin 2. One Android APK supports both games; install your own GameCube disc image in the launcher. Pikmin 2 is documented as playable from start to finish, with touch and controller support.
